verdict.rationale: Mercury's API Reference hub (docs.mercury.com/reference, built on ReadMe) provides an interactive explorer with a 'Try It!' live request runner, generated code samples across multiple languages, param/auth fields, and response schemas per endpoint, plus a dedicated Sandbox environment with pre-loaded dummy data for safe testing. missing for 10: no independently verified OpenAPI/swagger file was found (probe returned 404s on standard paths), and no hands-on independent review specifically confirms the 'Try It' runner works end-to-end.
